name: Evo CRM Platform
shortDescription: A modern customer relationship management platform.
longDescription: Evo CRM helps sales teams manage leads, track customer interactions, and close deals faster. We designed a sleek UI with dashboards, integrated email tools, and advanced reporting. Built for scale with cloud-based infrastructure.

name: SupplyChainPro
longDescription: SupplyChainPro is an enterprise-grade platform for planning, tracking, and optimizing supply chain logistics. Features include real-time shipment tracking, warehouse management, and predictive analytics. We engineered a robust microservices backend and intuitive admin UI.

name: Evo Mobile Banking App
shortDescription: Secure and user-friendly banking on the go.
longDescription: We developed a full-featured mobile banking app with biometric authentication, real-time notifications, seamless fund transfers, and bill payments. Designed for both iOS and Android with a unified design system.

name: SmartCity Dashboard
shortDescription: A central command center for urban management.
longDescription: The SmartCity Dashboard offers real-time monitoring of utilities, traffic, emergency services, and environmental sensors. We delivered a scalable backend with IoT integrations and a dynamic data visualization frontend.

name: Evo HR Portal
shortDescription: Streamlined HR operations in one place.
longDescription: The Evo HR Portal automates onboarding, leave management, payroll, and performance reviews. We focused on ease of use, role-based access, and integrations with existing enterprise systems.
